prompt: How many American artists have received more than 40 Grammy nominations?
answer: **26 American artists** have received more than 40 Grammy nominations, counting composers, producers, and recording engineers as well as performing artists. This includes Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Quincy Jones, Chick Corea, John Williams, Kanye West, Stevie Wonder, Henry Mancini, Kendrick Lamar, Leonard Bernstein, Willie Nelson, Taylor Swift, Dolly Parton, Bruce Springsteen, Babyface, Vince Gill, Emmylou Harris, Alison Krauss, Aretha Franklin, Eminem, Barbra Streisand, Tony Bennett, and others.
